description.value: Tap & Barrel's Convention Centre location occupies the West Building of the Vancouver Convention Centre with a large waterfront patio overlooking Burrard Inlet and the North Shore Mountains — a natural stop along the seawall cycling route. The chain runs its own BREWHALL Beer Co. brewery and spotlights BC-made beer and wine. The kitchen serves elevated comfort food with a menu filterable by dietary need.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 41m; rack at 44m; rack (16 spaces) at 51m; stands (covered) at 92m; stands (covered) at 95m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record maps to the Convention Centre location of this multi-location Vancouver chain; the website contact page confirms the address (76-1055 Canada Place, V6C 0C3) and phone (604-235-9827) match OSM exactly. The website prominently features 'ORDER TAKEOUT & DELIVERY' confirming takeout, and the OSM tag diet:gluten_free=yes is corroborated by the menu page's 'Filter our menu by diet' language. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM email (convention@tapandbarrel.com) is an events/convention contact, not the general business email — may reflect a narrower use context.
This is one of seven chain locations; other Tap & Barrel locations (Olympic Village, Shipyards, Bridges, etc.) may appear as separate OSM nodes and should be checked for duplicates.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Prime waterfront location on the Vancouver seawall cycling route, but no confirmed bike parking or other required cycling amenities found in website content; local verification of bike infrastructure at the Convention Centre precinct is needed before inclusion.

wow_evidence: large waterfront patio overlooking Burrard Inlet... natural stop along the seawall cycling route
